# Castel Sant'Angelo Rome

> > Your complete guide to visiting Castel Sant'Angelo (Hadrian's Mausoleum) in Rome: tickets, tours, history, and practical visitor information.

This site provides comprehensive information about visiting the National Museum of Castel Sant'Angelo in Rome, covering everything from ticket booking and opening hours to detailed guides about the castle's interior, historical prisons, papal apartments, and special events like the Girandola fireworks.
